# docker_compose_logs (Data Source)

Reads the logs of a compose project's containers, like `docker compose logs --timestamps`. Each container's last `tail` lines are read, merged in time order into `log_entries` (source `<service>.<container>`) and rendered as `logs`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_logs" "shop" {
  name     = "shop"
  services = ["web"]
  tail     = 100
  since    = "15m"
}

output "web_errors" {
  value     = [for e in data.docker_compose_logs.shop.log_entries : e.message if e.stream == "stderr"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Optional

- `services` (List of String) Only these services (default: every service of the project).
- `since` (String) Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set.
- `tail` (Number) Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all".

### Read-Only

- `container_ids` (Map of List of String) Map of service name to the IDs of its selected containers, in container-number order.
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of logs.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `log_entries` (Attributes List) One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is "<compose service>.<container name>". Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_entries))
- `logs` (String, Sensitive) The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets.

<a id="nestedatt--log_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `log_entries`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive.
- `source` (String) Upstream `Labels[com.docker.compose.service] + "." + Names[0] (leading "/" removed)`.
- `stream` (String) Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`.
- `timestamp` (String) Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`.
